snippet.title: Recycling Shift - Work at a Recycling Facility - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

Wishlist on Steam to be notified when the free demo is out: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3899920/Recycling_Shift/
